subject.title: feat(ios): read-only offline cache for chat sessions and transcripts

question: Should the iOS transcript cache purge rows when a paired gateway is forgotten or onboarding is reset before this PR can merge?
rationale: The PR introduces local persistence for sensitive transcript text and currently leaves forgotten-gateway cache retention as a follow-up, which is a product/security decision automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Require purge before merge
options.body: Add a cache purge path and wire it into gateway reset or forget flows so forgotten gateway transcript rows are removed with pairing state.

options.title: Accept bounded retention
options.body: Allow old per-gateway rows to linger until eviction, but make that retention behavior explicit in PR evidence and docs.

options.title: Pause for shared mobile contract
options.body: Hold this iOS PR until maintainers define one iOS and Android offline transcript cache and retention model.

recommendation.title: Require purge before merge
recommendation.body: Add a cache purge path and wire it into gateway reset or forget flows so forgotten gateway transcript rows are removed with pairing state.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the PR and linked mobile cache proposal in the affected iOS/shared chat surface.
